message_key.title: Message Key
message_key.description: i18n key translated by the web app, for example `errors.notFound`.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Short support reference, also logged with the trace id.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Filled for validation errors so forms can mark the fields.

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description:
RFC 9457 problem details. The UI shows `message_key` translated and `ref` as the support
reference; it never shows `code` or `title`.

date.title: Date
date.description: Place the order before this date (`order_by_date`).

earliest_date.title: Earliest Date
earliest_date.description: Earlier bound from high demand; `null` when high demand does not stock out either.

weeks_without_stock.title: Weeks Without Stock
weeks_without_stock.description: How long the product stays empty if the order is placed today.

context_product_code.title: Context Product Code
context_product_code.description: Set when the message was asked from a product's detail.

had_stockouts.description: Asked only when the file has no stock column.

ClarificationAnswers.title: ClarificationAnswers
ClarificationAnswers.description: Answers to the clarification card (05). Each is optional; at least one must be given.

column.title: Column
column.description: `null` when the file has no such column ("— No tengo esta columna —").

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Date format or decimal separator detected, when relevant.

ColumnMapping.title: ColumnMapping
ColumnMapping.description: One row of the mapping card.

current_job_id.title: Current Job Id
current_job_id.description: Active job, while digesting or calculating.

current_run_id.title: Current Run Id
current_run_id.description: Latest ready run, once the forecast exists.

deleted_at.title: Deleted At
deleted_at.description: Set while a soft delete can still be undone (30 days).

current_job_id.title: Current Job Id
current_job_id.description: Active job, while digesting or calculating.

current_run_id.title: Current Run Id
current_run_id.description: Latest ready run, once the forecast exists.

deleted_at.title: Deleted At
deleted_at.description: Set while a soft delete can still be undone (30 days).

ConversationStage.title: ConversationStage
ConversationStage.description: Driven by the backend, never inferred by the client (plan 2.1).

ConversationUpdate.title: ConversationUpdate
ConversationUpdate.description: PATCH: rename, pin or archive. Omitted fields stay.

CoverageRange.title: CoverageRange
CoverageRange.description:
Weeks of coverage. `lower` comes from high demand, `upper` from low demand; `null` means
no stockout inside the horizon ("sin quiebre en el horizonte").

count.title: Count
count.description: For example how many products have short history.

DefaultedParameter.title: DefaultedParameter
DefaultedParameter.description: Parameters the user did not answer, so the run used a default (shown in results).

FeedbackCreate.title: FeedbackCreate
FeedbackCreate.description: `null` clears a previous like or dislike.

field.title: Field
field.description: Dotted path inside the request part, for example `risk_thresholds.medium_margin_weeks`.

code.title: Code
code.description: Validation rule that failed, for example `string_too_short`.

FieldIssue.title: FieldIssue
FieldIssue.description: One invalid input. Never echoes the submitted value.

end.title: End
end.description: Character offsets into `display_text` (Unicode code points, end exclusive).

FilterAnnotation.title: FilterAnnotation
FilterAnnotation.description: A figure in the text that applies a filter when clicked.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many products match the filter.

FilterLink.title: FilterLink
FilterLink.description: A figure that maps to a results filter. Omitted fields do not filter.

ForecastRequest.title: ForecastRequest
ForecastRequest.description: Either the answers or `skip: true` ("Omitir y pronosticar ahora").

defaults_used.title: Defaults Used
defaults_used.description: Parameters the user skipped, so the results must say a default was used.

parameters_pending.title: Parameters Pending
parameters_pending.description:
`parameters` were saved from the drawer but the results still use the previous values
until "Recalcular".

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Only the stages of this job, in order: the stepper renders exactly these.

total.title: Total
total.description: Products processed so far / to process, when known. No percentage is ever sent.

error_ref.title: Error Ref
error_ref.description: Short support code when the job failed.

JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted
JobAccepted.description: 202 body for operations that enqueue a job.

JobUpdateEvent.title: JobUpdateEvent
JobUpdateEvent.description:
SSE `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/events`: sent on every stage or progress change and once at the
end. Wire format: `event: job.update` and `data: <this object as JSON>`.

MappingPayload.title: MappingPayload
MappingPayload.description: The confirmation card; its data comes from `GET /conversations/{id}/plan`.

MovementRule.title: MovementRule
MovementRule.description: Kardex only: which movement codes count as demand (01 sales minus 05 returns).

MovementTreatment.title: MovementTreatment
MovementTreatment.description: How a Kardex movement code is treated: sales minus customer returns are demand.

date.description: `null` means the file has no date column (screen 08b, "Mi archivo no tiene fechas").

PlanConfirmation.title: PlanConfirmation
PlanConfirmation.description: PUT body. `plan: null` confirms the proposed plan as is; a plan replaces it (Corregir).

plan.description:
`null` for Kardex files (fixed layout, see `movement_rules`) and while no usable plan
exists (needs a date column).

Preferences.title: Preferences
Preferences.description: PUT replaces the whole object. Also used as the response.

end.title: End
end.description: Character offsets into `display_text` (Unicode code points, end exclusive).

ProductAnnotation.title: ProductAnnotation
ProductAnnotation.description: A product mention that opens its detail.

purchase.description: `purchase` and both projections are `null` when the file had no stock column.

with_suggested_purchase.description: The suggested quantity (low bound) arriving at the lead time ("Con compra sugerida").

series.title: Series
series.description: History (with censored weeks) followed by the forecast range, without projected stock.

ProductForecast.title: ProductForecast
ProductForecast.description: The forecast on its own: no stock involved, so it exists even if the file had no stock.

ProductOverrides.title: ProductOverrides
ProductOverrides.description: Per-product values. `null` clears the override and falls back to the run defaults.

total.title: Total
total.description: Products matching the filters ("12" of "12 de 142 en foco").

series.title: Series
series.description: History, forecast range and projected stock for the chart.

typical_demand.description: Mean weekly demand over the next 4 weeks.

suggested_truncated.title: Suggested Truncated
suggested_truncated.description: The horizon is shorter than lead time + target coverage, so the figure is partial.

ProductRow.title: ProductRow
ProductRow.description:
When the run's file had no stock column (`RunSummary.stock_known` is false) every field that
depends on stock is `null`: `current_stock`, `coverage_weeks`, `risk`, `stockout_date`,
`suggested_quantity` and `buy_before`. Demand and reliability are still there.

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description: PATCH semantics: omitted fields stay, `null` clears `job_title`.

QuantityRange.title: QuantityRange
QuantityRange.description: A low-high range, for example the suggested purchase.

backtest_error_pct.title: Backtest Error Pct
backtest_error_pct.description: Weekly WAPE from the rolling backtest; `null` without enough history.

ReliabilityDetail.title: ReliabilityDetail
ReliabilityDetail.description: Plain-language reliability plus the technical detail behind "Ver detalle técnico".

RiskThresholds.title: RiskThresholds
RiskThresholds.description:
Risk bands in weeks above the lead time: critical below `lead + critical_margin`, medium
below `lead + medium_margin`.

products_at_risk.description:
Products with critical risk, with the filter that lists them. `null` when the file had no
stock column (`RunSummary.stock_known` is false): risk cannot be known.

average_coverage_weeks.description:
Mean over products; a product without stockout counts as the horizon (lower bound).
`null` when stock is unknown.

lead_time_days.title: Lead Time Days
lead_time_days.description: Default lead time; products can override it.

RunParameters.title: RunParameters
RunParameters.description: Parameters drawer. Also used as the response.

stock_known.title: Stock Known
stock_known.description: The file had a stock column. Without it stock is assumed 0 and results are indicative.

ScenarioValues.title: ScenarioValues
ScenarioValues.description:
One figure per demand scenario. For derived figures such as projected stock, `low` is the
figure under low demand, so it is not necessarily the smallest value.

censored.title: Censored
censored.description: The week was affected by a stockout, so `actual` is a lower bound.

SeriesPoint.title: SeriesPoint
SeriesPoint.description: One chart point. Only the fields that apply to the date are set.

purchase_quantity.title: Purchase Quantity
purchase_quantity.description: Quantity arriving at the lead time; defaults to the suggested low bound.

SimulationRequest.title: SimulationRequest
SimulationRequest.description: What-if over the persisted forecast. Omitted fields keep the product's current values.

status_key.title: Status Key
status_key.description: i18n key of the human status line ("Revisando productos críticos…").

default.title: Default
default.description: Unit of measure used when the file has no unit column.

UomSeries.title: UomSeries
UomSeries.description: Aggregate series for one unit of measure (units cannot be added together).

UploadCompleted.title: UploadCompleted
UploadCompleted.description: Step 2 result: the conversation and its digest job.

UploadCreate.title: UploadCreate
UploadCreate.description:
Step 1: ask for a signed upload URL. The browser then uploads the file straight to
storage, because Vercel caps request bodies at 4.5 MB.

upload_url.title: Upload Url
upload_url.description: Signed URL, valid for a short time.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Headers the browser must send with the upload.

email.title: Email
email.description: Read-only: comes from the identity provider.

company.description: Read-only: the tenant the user belongs to (one tenant per user in v1).

SupabaseJWT.description: Supabase access token. The tenant is resolved server-side from membership.
